~/about

Built by developers.For developers.

  • Clean Architecture

    Strict boundaries, cohesive modules, and code that documents itself.

  • Developer Experience

    Frictionless setup, honest documentation, and sensible defaults out of the box.

  • Ruthless Performance

    Lean bundles, edge computing, and a sub-100ms first paint from day one.

  • Zero-Trust Security

    Validated input, least-privilege access, and absolutely no secrets in source control.

  • Infinite Scalability

    Structured to grow seamlessly from a weekend prototype to millions of users.

  • Privacy by Design

    Collect the bare minimum. Encrypt what you keep. Respect the user always.

  • Open Standards

    Web standards, portable formats, and open APIs over proprietary lock-in.
